ꜣgb: ꜣgb — flood, flood-water, inundation (noun m.; written with three lines of water; Budge: aḳab 'the water floods')
ngg-wr: ngg-wr — Negeg-wer, 'the Great Cackler', a goose god of the beginning of things (god's name; from ngg 'cackle' and wr 'great'; Budge: Neḳeḳ ur)
nḫt: nḫt — to be strong, mighty (verb; written with the arm with a stick, the classifier of force)
ssn: ssn — to breathe, smell (verb 3-lit.; written with the nose as classifier; Budge: sesen 'smell')
wḏꜥ-ꜣꜥb: wḏꜥ-ꜣꜥb — Wedja-aab, a name the speaker takes for himself, not understood (name; the first part perhaps wḏꜥ 'judge, separate', the second, ꜣꜥb, not known; Budge: Utcha-aāb)
bkꜣ: bkꜣ — to grow light, dawn (?) (verb; with the sun as classifier; Budge: beka, 'destroy (?)') · a second word of the same spelling: to be pregnant (verb)

__broaden__.nḏm: nḏm — to be sweet, pleasant (verb; nḏm ib 'glad of heart'; Budge: net'em) · also the adjective used as a noun, 'the sweet one'
